title: List Hadwiger Conjecture
exact_target: Conjecture Every $K_t$-minor-free graph is $c t$-list-colourable for some constant $c\geq1$.
definition_tex:
\subsection{Definitions and mathematical statement}
\paragraph{Shared notation.}$\mathbb N$, $\mathbb Z$, $\mathbb Q$, $\mathbb R$, and $\mathbb C$ denote the natural numbers, integers, rationals, reals, and complex numbers, respectively. All additional parameters and hypotheses are specified in the question.


\paragraph{Statement recorded in the supplied source.}
Conjecture Every $K_t$-minor-free graph is $c t$-list-colourable for some constant $c\geq1$.
\par\smallskip\textit{Formulation references:} \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/ulamai/UnsolvedMath}{[S1]}, \href{http://www.openproblemgarden.org/op/list_hadwiger_conjecture}{[S2]}, \href{http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Graph_minor}{[S3]}, \href{http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_coloring}{[S4]}, \href{http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/0012-365X(93)90557-A}{[S5]}, \href{http://www.combinatorics.org/ojs/index.php/eljc/article/view/v18i1p232}{[S6]}, \href{http://www.ams.org/mathscinet-getitem?mr=593902}{[S8]}, \href{http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.jctb.2006.11.002}{[S9]}, \href{http://www.ams.org/mathscinet-getitem?mr=MR2325803}{[S10]}, \href{http://dx.doi.org/10.1007/BF01202354}{[S11]}, \href{http://www.ams.org/mathscinet-getitem?mr=1238823}{[S12]}, \href{http://dx.doi.org/10.1006/jctb.1994.1062}{[S13]}, \href{http://www.ams.org/mathscinet-getitem?mr=MR1290638}{[S14]}.

\subsection{Short English statement}
Conjecture Every $K_t$-minor-free graph is $c t$-list-colourable for some constant $c\geq1$.
